description: This file defines the CacheTicketStore class implementing ITicketStore for managing authentication tickets with distributed cache and data protection.

classes.name: CacheTicketStore
classes.description: Implements ITicketStore to handle authentication tickets with caching and data protection.

methods.name: RemoveAsync
methods.description: Removes a cached authentication ticket by key.

methods.name: RenewAsync
methods.description: Renews and stores an authentication ticket in the cache.

methods.name: RetrieveAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication ticket from the cache by key.

methods.name: StoreAsync
methods.description: Stores an authentication ticket in the cache and returns its generated key.

methods.name: SerializeTicket
methods.description: Serializes an AuthenticationTicket to byte array.

methods.name: DeserializeTicket
methods.description: Deserializes byte array to an AuthenticationTicket.
